# ShapingAPI

The [UsdLux](glossary.md#usdlux) shaping controls of a light (focus, cone, IES profile). Render-only: the parser reads no column of it. It is a component only so the [compiled stage cache](glossary.md#compiled-stage-cache) does not bypass a Stage whose render prims carry it.

- **Applies to:** [`NonboundableLightBase`](glossary.md#nonboundablelightbase), [`BoundableLightBase`](glossary.md#boundablelightbase)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by [USD](glossary.md#usd) population when a RENDERING description is populated beside the physics description (as [IsaacLab](glossary.md#isaaclab) populates), which keeps render prims; the physics description alone leaves it out.
